[[Galactic Solutions Industries]] maintained a '''Superweapons Division''' that researched and developed [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]]. The [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang stole sensitive research from the division, but when their ship crashed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], GSI operatives were able to retrieve the data.
